entry_points.text: Deferred process and interrupt work armed during init. Queue exposes wake and release operations for external callers.
Scatter init and chained allocation plus top extraction which rejects zero budgets, routes user, vector, folio queue and xarray kinds and fails unsupported with IO error.

exports.text: Blocking insert retries inner attempt while transient contention persists. Successor lookup scans current and successor tables for next distinct key.
Walker registration links iterator at table start with position reset. Session start takes read protection and validates position, stop releases and rejoins roster.
Init validates config, prepares sync, normalizes bounds, selects hash, allocates and publishes buckets and arms work. Nested access resolves hash through layers, creating missing ones on insert.
Bitmap setup creates word state and per cpu hints for depth and granularity. Allocation returns free index or failure marker.
Batch claim takes tags within one word from hint with wrap. Wakeups batch completions. Release clears tags with wake accounting. Waiter add tracks association.
Counting derives total entries. Init clears storage and marks chains. Chained alloc links chunks reserving link slots and marking end. Free walks chain releasing pieces.

Copy moves bytes between linear buffer and list with optional skip using local mapping. Extraction routes iterator kinds to handlers. Pooled chained alloc reuses first chunk. Order lists cover length with pages.
Sequential buffer accepts text appends with overflow signaling. Used content goes to sequence files. Binary format renderer decodes directives into bounded output with termination.

hazards.text: EAGAIN signals transient retry, EEXIST duplicate, ENOENT missing predecessor, EOPNOTSUPP list mode, EINVAL bad config or size, ENOMEM exhaustion.
Concurrent resize relocates entries, so walks avoid rejoining reclaiming tables. Release orders data before clear and clear before waiter checks since cleared tags reuse immediately.
Init validates config with smallest size retry. Zero, oversize and no chain rejected, overflow empty, page failure unwinds pages and list, append failure restores tail.
Warnings indicate caller violations: shallow below floor, consumed beyond exposed length and terminal without end mark.
Oversize destinations warn and empty with clamped lengths. Zero size warns on append. Unexpected xarray entries warn and stop emission.

Pool setup creates cache plus mempool per class, tearing all down with ENOMEM on failure. Failed user extraction unpins new pages in reverse. Missing hints warn and fail, exhaustion returns negative resetting hints.

invariants.text: Count increments only on true add. Conflict without growth preserves existing. Load past three quarters schedules maintenance. Lingering contention triggers rehash.
Successor hashes predecessor, uses caller comparator else default, skips equal run and returns next distinct. Default hash uses word variant when key length word aligned.
Initial capacity inflates hint by four thirds and rounds up, bounded by minimum and defaults. Maximum count capped to avoid overflow, derived from rounded down max size.
Nested consumes low bits then page chunks via protected refs. Words ceil depth over bits. Hints repair when outside depth and reset when full.
No waiters suppress wakeups. Completions release in batch units with rotating start. Waiter count equals associated objects. Chains end mark final and reserve link slots.

Merging needs contiguous frames with compatible device memory bounded by page aligned max. Page counts round offset plus length up. Append needs current plus request within capacity, strings reserve terminator.
Counts of eight or fewer use first pool, larger map by order offset within max. Kernel vector splits at page boundaries with separate handling for vmalloc versus direct addresses.

locks.text: Mutation serializes lookup plus insert under per bucket guard. Roster changes use table spin. Read sections protect retries and scans. Barrier orders successor observation.
Word reclaim uses interrupt saving spin. Claims use atomics with ordered release and barriers around waiter checks. Xarray extraction holds RCU read lock during lookup walk.

state_machines.text: Insertion loops protected attempt, locked insert and accounting, repeating on new table and converting contention to rehash. Walking goes idle to protected scanning across slots and successors with restart to end.
Allocation maps hint to start word and scans with wrap to exhaustion. Waiters move unassociated to associated with count on first association and back on detach.
Mapping cycles idle to mapped with page window, releasing on stop. Append moves empty to headed to terminated, linking new chunk on reservation.
Appends stay writable while room remains and latch to overflow on shortage, reporting failure until external reset.

structs.text: Iterator holds table ref, slot plus skip, saved positions, end marker and roster link. Table holds params, counts, current ref, list flag, lock, mutex and deferred work.

Bitmap holds depth, shift, word count, hints and words with live, deferred and guard. Queue adds wake state, counters and waits. Tables hold head and counts. Mapping iterators hold page window with mode.
Hash defaults with four thirds inflation and 2^31 cap, word width, bounded wake batch, single alloc threshold selecting storage, pools reserve two with 8 and 16 plus larger.
